cs.label: [section] Cíl předmětu a studijní výstupy:
cs.content: Cílem kurzu je poskytnout znalosti v oblasti pokročilých teorií i metod mezinárodního investičního managementu. Předmět se zaměří na komplikované rozhodovací procesy v oblasti řízení a optimalizaci mezinárodních investičních portfolií. Studenti získají dovednosti tvorby hedgových strategií a optimalizace portfolií na mezinárodních finančních trzích.

en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: The aim of the course is to provide knowledge in the field of advanced theories and methods of international investment management. The course will focus on complex decision-making processes in management and the optimization of international investment portfolios. Students will acquire skills in developing hedging strategies and optimizing portfolios in international financial markets.

en.label: [section] Assessment methods:
en.content: The course credit is awarded after the student presents a case study involving the optimization of a portfolio based on real data, using predefined criteria and underlying assets. Through this, the student demonstrates not only knowledge of portfolio management but also the ability to solve real-world problems in international investment management. The course concludes with an oral exam. Successful completion of the course requires achieving at least 60% in the case study presentation and 60% in the oral exam.
